reply_text:
I've saved Marcus's note and replied to him in his DM (DHARNES0001).

- **Memory:** I saved that his standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is Thursdays at 16:30 from now on, and added it to the memory index. Because he told me this in a DM, the note says to use it only when answering Marcus and not to repeat it to other members or in channels.
- **Reply to Marcus:** "Got it, Marcus. I've noted that your standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is now Thursdays at 16:30. I haven't changed anything on your calendar."
- **Calendar:** I didn't touch it, since he said no action was needed.

My first attempt to message him by name failed because the directory had no member listed as "Marcus Lindqvist," so nothing went out that way. I posted the reply straight into the DM where his message came in instead.
